sections.text_helper: Section 34.3.13 "Clock dividers for digital filters" in chapter 34 (General-purpose timers (TIM12)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1304.
sections.section_content:
The digital filters (for tim_tix) are using a DTS_ck clock (with a tDTS period), derived from the
tim_ker_ck clock.
A prescaler can decrease the frequency to extend the DTS_ck clock period programmed
with the CKD[1:0] bitfield in the TIM_CR1 register. A second prescaler can decrease the
resulting DTS_ck clock to extend the digital filters range, with the CKD2[3:0] bitfield in the
TIM_CR1 register.
[Figure 455. Clock prescalers for digital filters]
